intent: Framed tile with optional header, body, and footer actions.
useWhen: Grouped content that should sit on a card surface
A table card: title over a DataTable (flush), with View all as a footer action
A compact table card: size sm + flush over a DataTable
A data tile with a header row (icon, eyebrow, time, X), a source line and a footer with Ask and one primary

title.note: 16/24 at heading weight in both sizes: the smallest of three title sizes (page 24, section 18, card 16).

headingLevel.note: Heading level of the title. Use 1 when the card title is the page heading (e.g. Sign in), 3 or 4 when the card sits under a page or Section heading. Only the element changes; the 16/24 title look stays the same.

children.note: Body. Compose kit Field/Input/Button/Badge/etc, never a local cousin. The card does not clip content, so DatePicker, Select, and DropdownMenu overlays open past its edge.

size.note: sm = compact padding (space.4); md = space.6. Both use the 16/24 card title (md type.size.uiMd / type.line.uiMd, sm type.size.body); only padding differs. The footer's block padding is space.4 on md and space.3 on sm. Size never sets width: the card fills its container, so width comes from the layout (wrap it, e.g. max-width 24rem, for a narrow tile).

headerAction.note: Header kit Button, or up to two (an array), e.g. an icon-only Ask and View all. Ghost or outline, not a second solid-primary. href is deprecated: it still renders a real link with the sm Button look, but prefer a footer action. iconStart adds a leading icon; iconOnly with iconStart makes it icon-only, named by label. More than two: the rest are ignored, with a warning in development.

label.note: Button text, or the accessible name when iconOnly

iconStart.note: Leading Lucide icon (curated name, component or element)

iconOnly.note: With iconStart: icon-only Button, named by label (aria-label and title)

href.note: Deprecated: still renders a real link (<a href>, or linkAs) with the sm Button look. Prefer a footer action or a header Button with onClick.

linkAs.note: Deprecated with href: router link to render instead of <a>, e.g. Next.js Link. Receives href, className, onClick, children

flush.note: Body edge to edge with no padding; header and footer keep padding with a divider. A DataTable directly in the body drops its own frame (border, radius, shadow). Its first and last columns take the card's inline padding at any size (space.6 md, space.4 sm), whatever the table's cellSize, so the title lines up with the first column and headerAction with the last. Use for table cards; give the DataTable ariaLabel instead of a caption so the title is not repeated.

actions.note: Footer kit Buttons (md), max 2, right-aligned after Ask, still one solid-primary per view. The footer sits under a divider.

icon.note: Header row: a small icon tile (surface.muted, icon.muted) before the eyebrow. aria-hidden.

eyebrow.note: Header row: short grey label, e.g. 'Analytics'. Caller copy, not a heading.

meta.note: Header row: timestamp on the right, e.g. '12:04', tabular numbers. Not a heading.

onDismiss.note: Header row: X IconButton sm (32), ghost neutral, named by KitLabels dismiss.

source.note: Grey caption under the body naming where the data comes from, e.g. 'Stripe · last 30 days'. Describes the article (aria-describedby).

onAsk.note: Footer: neutral ghost Button sm with MessageCircle (aria-hidden) on the left. Shown only with askLabel.

askLabel.note: Caller label for Ask, e.g. 'Ask' or 'Ask in Chat'.

imageSrc.note: Full-bleed image above the content; its top corners take the card radius

requirements: title is a heading when set (h2 by default, headingLevel 1, 3 or 4) with useId
An icon-only headerAction is a Button named by its label
A header action with href is a link (role link) named by its label, not a button
With icon, eyebrow, meta or onDismiss the header row comes before the title; eyebrow and meta are text, not headings; the icon tile is aria-hidden
The X is an IconButton named by KitLabels dismiss
source is referenced by aria-describedby on the article
Ask is a Button with a visible label; its MessageCircle icon is aria-hidden

doNot: Do not invent local Card, Panel, or Tile
Do not use Card as a Scorecard-in-disguise — do not put a lone metric here
Do not use Card for page grouping — that is unframed Section
Footer actions must be kit Buttons
headerAction is ghost/outline, not a second solid-primary
Do not nest a framed DataTable in a padded Card — set flush
Do not repeat the Card title as the DataTable caption — use DataTable ariaLabel
Do not put more than two header actions; move the rest to the footer or a DropdownMenu
Do not make an icon-only header action without a label that names what it does, e.g. Ask about Plan mix
Do not use headerAction href for new work; it is deprecated. Put View all in the footer actions
Do not make Ask a primary Button, or put a second solid-primary in the footer
Do not draw a local eyebrow, timestamp, close button or source line; pass eyebrow, meta, onDismiss and source
Do not skip heading levels: pick headingLevel from the headings above the card, and use 1 only when the card title is the page's only h1
